The '''2026–27 season''' is the 145th season in the history of [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur Football Club]], their 49th consecutive season in the top flight of [[English football league system|English football]], and 35th consecutive season in the [[Premier League]]. In addition to the [[2026–27 Premier League|domestic league]], the club is also participating in the [[2026–27 FA Cup|FA Cup]] and the [[2025–26 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]].

This season is the first since [[2020–21 Tottenham Hotspur F.C. season|2020–21]] without former captain [[Cristian Romero]], who signed for [[Atlético Madrid]] in the summer.

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 7 December 2025, the club announced they would take part in the [[2026 Sydney Super Cup]] with matches against [[Sydney FC]] and [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Club to visit Sydney on 2026 pre-season tour |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2025/december/club-to-visit-sydney-on-2026-pre-season-tour/ |access-date=21 January 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=7 December 2025}}</ref> In March, a pre-season tour to [[New Zealand]] was also announced with a fixture against [[Auckland FC]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Club to visit Auckland as part of 2026 Pre-Season Tour |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2026/march/tottenham-hotspur-to-visit-auckland-as-part-of-2026-pre-season-tour/ |access-date=30 March 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=29 March 2026}}</ref> On 12 June, a [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]] fixture against [[Milton Keynes Dons F.C.|Milton Keynes Dons]] was announced.<ref>{{cite news |title=Fourth pre-season fixture confirmed for Men's First Team |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1073110/fourth-pre-season-fixture-confirmed-for-mens-first-team-mk-dons |access-date=12 June 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=12 June 2026}}</ref> On 29 June, a home fixture against [[TSG 1899 Hoffenheim|TSG Hoffenheim]] was added to the schedule.<ref>{{cite news |title=Club announces pre-season friendlies against TSG 1899 Hoffenheim |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1075555/club-announces-pre-season-friendlies-against-tsg-1899-hoffenheim |access-date=29 June 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=29 June 2026}}</ref> On 5 July, a second [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]] fixture was added against [[Getafe CF|Getafe]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Getafe fixture added to pre-season schedule |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1076377/getafe-fixture-added-to-pre-season-schedule |access-date=5 July 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=5 July 2026}}</ref>

===EFL Cup===
{{main|2026–27 EFL Cup}}

''Spurs'' entered the EFL Cup in the second round, and were drawn at home to [[Charlton Athletic F.C.|Charlton Athletic]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Charlton at home in Carabao Cup second round |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1083594/charlton-in-carabao-cup-second-round-draw-2026-27 |access-date=11 August 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=10 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Spurs vs Charlton, Carabao Cup {{!}} Date and KO time confirmed |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1084493/spurs-vs-charlton-carabao-cup-date-and-ko-time-confirmed |access-date=14 August 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=12 August 2026}}</ref> They were then drawn away to [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] in the third round.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool away in the Carabao Cup third round |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1087005/liverpool-away-in-the-carabao-cup-third-round |access-date=27 August 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=26 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Date, kick-off time and ticket news |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/1087444/date-kick-off-time-and-ticket-news-liverpool-vs-spurs-carabao-cup |access-date=28 August 2026 |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=28 August 2026}}</ref>
